Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt is a healthcare cluster operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. It is actively monitored in the annual quality reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) regarding the treatment and management of [[atrieflimren]] in the Danish healthcare system.

The cluster's performance is evaluated across multiple clinical quality indicators. For Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed patients, Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt meets the established standard, achieving a result of 91.3% [^src1]. It also demonstrated strong performance in [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which tracks the use of echocardiography as a diagnostic tool; the cluster recorded the highest proportion of echocardiography execution among all clusters at 89.4% (95% CI: 87.4–91.2) [^src2]. Furthermore, the cluster fulfills the standard for [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]], which measures the frequency of annual P-creatinine measurements for patients on DOAC treatment [^src5].

Beyond diagnostic and treatment initiation metrics, Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt is tracked for long-term treatment coverage [^src3] [^src4], incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src5], severe bleeding [^src7], and heart failure outcomes [^src8]. Geographically, the cluster is part of the national mapping of atrial fibrillation outcomes, with the incidence of stroke falling within the broader national distribution intervals [^src5]. Overall, the data highlights Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt as a key organizational unit in the regional and national quality improvement strategies for cardiovascular care.
